subject: wrinkly fingers
title: What If You Stayed in the Bath for Hours?

scenes.text: What if you stayed in the bath for hours? Your fingers wouldn't be soaking up water.
After about half an hour in warm water, your fingertips are deeply wrinkled. Most people blame soaked-up bathwater.
But it's your nerves. They tell the blood vessels under your skin to narrow, and the surface folds in.
Since the 1930s, scientists have known that if a finger's nerves are cut, it doesn't wrinkle at all.
In one test, wrinkled fingers moved wet marbles about 12 percent faster. With dry objects, no difference.
Pruney fingers aren't damage. They may be rain treads your body switches on, in the same pattern every time.
